title: Four pool rows on the Autopilot motherboard question check the hybrid-join line of autopilot/lifecycle.md, so no arm passes them
goal: The rows BP-ff6bf9a2, BP-8be31bb6, BP-82c356ad and BP-e64bdaf9 check a fact line that answers what happens to the Autopilot device record when the motherboard is replaced, so an arm that answers it passes; in the pool record of 2026-10-09 no arm (the hook included) passed any of the four, and their check names autopilot/lifecycle.md:13, a line about the two Entra device objects of a hybrid join.

run: import csv,re,json; r=next(x for x in csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv')) if x['id']=='BP-ff6bf9a2'); l=open('kb/public/autopilot/lifecycle.md').read().splitlines()[12]; assert not any(re.search(c,l) for c in json.loads(r['checks'])), 'the check matches the hybrid-join line'

repro_reason: the defect is the committed check text of a pool row; the behaviour (no arm passing) needs a paid pool run

run: import subprocess,sys; o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/benchmarks.py','pool','build','--redo','EV-autopilot-device-record-motherboard-replaced','--dry-run'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; sys.exit(0 if 'lifecycle.md:' in o and 'lifecycle.md:13' not in o else 1)

notes: Cause: bench_pool.fact_for scores body lines by exact shared words, so line 13 (autopilot, device: 2) beats the motherboard lines 14, 21 and 22 (motherboard only; replaced/replacement differ); pool build --redo --dry-run still names autopilot/lifecycle.md:13, so a redo alone repeats the wrong check. Committed to SP-7y6dk257 at the operator's request of 2026-10-09 (benchmark follow-ups): its rows are unscored in the pool record of 2026-10-09.
